summary.text: John Larochelle is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives who has represented Strafford 19 since December 2024 and is running for re-election in Strafford 7 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: John Larochelle was born in Rochester, New Hampshire, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of New Hampshire and a graduate degree from Iowa State University.
His career experience includes working as a professor.
Larochelle assumed office on December 4, 2024, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026.
